name: WE-065 Brisklund wheat deficiency payment (loop seed)

unclear.text: Actual output or a historical base: payable to the holder of each registered farm on the farm's wheat production for the crop year; wheat production is what the Farm Register records for the farm (annual harvest declarations and established production).
readings: U1-a: the payment is on the harvest declared for the crop year (actual output)
U1-b: the payment is on the farm's established production (2022 to 2026 average); the crop year fixes only the year whose price sets the rate

a1.text: The Act is in force for 2028 to 2032 and payments are made as it provides.

a2.text: The national average price falls below Th 220 in at least one of the five crop years.

a10.text: The domestic farm-gate price follows export parity in every year (Brisklund exports in every year).

a11.text: Land buyers expected the Act from February 2027 and expect it to run its term, with some chance of renewal.

a18.text: The effect of Brisklund's added output on the world price is far smaller than the expected payment per tonne.
